name: Khaubaluk
backstory: Child of Merluko and Khaubalo; grew up around works out of the temple's own records annex... in Gorff, and knows something of Birth Of Niemornak.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Learned that Auroboro has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Aurebalo and Mekoboro now have a child, Aurekobo.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Merluko, named Merkhaubo.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Mekestros and Aureluko now have a child, Mekaluko.
Had a child with Mekoboro, named Mekobaluk.
Had a child with Aurekomest, named Khaubomest.
Heard that Aurekomest and Aurelkhau now have a child, Aureskomest.
Had a child with Aurekhobo, named Khaubekho.
Heard that Mekobaluk and Mekaurelo now have a child, Mekaurobal.
Had a child with Mekhaobako, named Khaubomako.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Birth Of Dorakus their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Birth Of Dorakus as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: sells iron work in the afternoons, still counting deliveries against the lean seasons she's only ever heard about secondhand
sells iron work in the afternoons, still counting deliveries against the lean seasons she's only ever heard about secondhand

arc.premise: Between her ledger work and her ironmongering, Khaubaluk wants her own family's ironwork - brackets, fittings, the frame hardware - commissioned for the market roof, making sure the project that keeps losing to the temple's repairs finally has her trade's stake in it too.
